// --- Source Part ---
Trips:
NoConcatenate
LOAD
    trip_id,
    load_id,
    driver_id,
    truck_id,
    ApplyMap('TruckMap', truck_id, 'Unknown') as TruckNumber,
    trailer_id,

    Date(dispatch_date) as DispatchDate,
    Month(dispatch_date) as TripMonth,
    Month(dispatch_date) as LoadMonth,
    MonthStart(dispatch_date) as MonthStartDate,
	MonthName(dispatch_date) as MonthYear,
	Num(MonthStart(dispatch_date)) as MonthSort,
    Year(dispatch_date) as TripYear,
    Week(dispatch_date) as TripWeek,
    Num(Month(dispatch_date)) as MonthNo,

    actual_distance_miles,
    actual_duration_hours,
    fuel_gallons_used,
    average_mpg,
    idle_time_hours,
    trip_status,
    
    If(
        actual_distance_miles >= 1000,
        'Long Haul',
        If(actual_distance_miles >= 500,
            'Medium Haul',
            'Short Haul'
        )
    ) as DistanceBand,
    
    If(
    average_mpg >= 8,
    'High MPG',
    If(
        average_mpg >= 6,
        'Medium MPG',
        'Low MPG'
    )
) as FuelEfficiencyBand,

If(
    idle_time_hours >= 5,
    'High Idle',
    If(
        idle_time_hours >= 2,
        'Moderate Idle',
        'Low Idle'
    )
) as IdleTimeBand

Resident Trips_Raw

    Count(DISTINCT trip_id) AS TotalTrips,

    Sum(fuel_gallons_used) AS TotalFuelGallons,

    Avg(idle_time_hours) AS AvgIdleHours,
    Sum(idle_time_hours) AS TotalIdleHours
Resident Trips
